rules.description: Documented manifest properties have valid shapes.
Field aliases are unique within each dataset mapping.
Dataset and field mapping definitions are well formed.
Advanced request proxy configuration is checked conditionally.
Literal dataset requests use aliases declared in the manifest.
Dynamic Domo GET paths are reported as unverified.
AppDB usage is identified without claiming live validation.
Domo CLI executable availability is checked without reading credentials.

diagnostics.explanation: No problems were detected by this check.

diagnostics.message: Documented manifest properties have valid shapes.
diagnostics.explanation: No problems were detected by this check.

diagnostics.message: proxyId is present, but its validity was not checked.
diagnostics.explanation: A local static scan cannot confirm that this proxyId is valid for the app, current card, or Domo instance.
diagnostics.suggestion: Verify advanced proxy behavior with the Domo CLI in the intended Domo environment.

diagnostics.message: Domo CLI executable was found on PATH.
diagnostics.explanation: Executable availability was checked from PATH only. Authentication, credentials, network access, and proxy behavior were not checked.

diagnostics.message: AppDB usage could not be checked in an incompletely analyzed source file.
diagnostics.explanation: This file was not parsed, so the absence of AppDB references cannot be established.

diagnostics.message: A source file could not be fully analyzed.
diagnostics.explanation: This file was not parsed, so dataset references in it were not checked.
diagnostics.suggestion: Check file size, syntax, and supported source formats before relying on this result.

diagnostics.message: Source file could not be fully analyzed.
diagnostics.explanation: HTML inline scripts, oversized or deeply nested files, and files with parse errors are not checked by this release.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use a supported JavaScript or TypeScript file, fix syntax errors, or split oversized and deeply nested source; verify remaining requests at runtime.

diagnostics.message: AppDB-related source detected; collection configuration was not verified.
diagnostics.explanation: This release does not validate collection declarations. Static text matching cannot establish collection existence, permissions, authentication, or runtime request correctness.
diagnostics.suggestion: Verify collection names, permissions, and request behavior in a Domo environment. This scan does not send AppDB requests or modify data.
